description: ONE-SHOT 'CHEAPEST MODEL FOR THIS DOMAIN' answer. Faster than recommend_model when the user just wants the budget option. Returns top 3 by price + the pick + `savings` field with concrete USD saved per call vs the domain flagship (often 5-10x). **Tell the user the savings + project to their volume** — 'cheapest pick at $0.02/img saves ~$0.06/call vs Midjourney; for 100 images = $6 saved'. Use whenever cost is dominant constraint — startup MVP, throwaway prototype, content farm.

max_budget_usd.description: Hard ceiling per unit, e.g. 0.05 to filter out anything above $0.05 per image.

min_quality.description: Optional quality floor — currently advisory only; pricing-sorted result still includes a quality column the agent can self-filter.

name: pick_cheapest_model
